registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to medium; unannounced inspections rare for standard retail SL but may occur during tax audits or AML reviews, with quantified risk approximately 5-10% for non-compliant entities

incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED by the First Board of Directors of the Company on [Date]: The sole shareholder subscribes to the full share capital of €3,000 by subscribing to quotas. The registered office is adopted at [Registered Office Address]. [Administrator Name] is appointed as the sole administrator. The administrator is authorized to sign all incorporation documents and file with the Registro Mercantil. The Company object is defined as social commerce through short video platforms such as TikTok Shop. This resolution is adopted unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Notarize Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Spanish notary to prepare the 'Escritura de Constitución' detailing the company name, object (social commerce via TikTok Shop), share capital, registered office, and initial administrator appointments. Ensure all shareholders' IDs and capital proof are provided.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries the application, provide additional documentation or revise the articles accordingly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central via Online Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Escritura de Constitución electronically through the Sede Electrónica del Registro Mercantil using a digital certificate. Include all supporting documents and pay any applicable fees.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, submit corrections within the specified period to avoid rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) online or in person at the tax office. Register the company for corporate income tax and VAT if applicable.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If rejected, resubmit the application with any missing or corrected documents.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and occupational health clearance from local authorities if operating physical premises

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); Sede Electrónica: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es; operational languages: Spanish; digital interaction via FNMT electronic certificate, Cl@ve PIN, or delegated 'apoderamiento' registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Procedure for a foreign-owned Spanish SL: (1) Prior to incorporation, the promoter (socio fundador), including a non-resident foreign individual or entity, files Modelo 036 with AEAT to obtain a provisional NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) for the SL; a Spanish tax representative with an authenticated power of attorney may be required for non-resident investors. (2) The provisional NIF is quoted in the public deed of incorporation (escritura de constitución), executed before a Spanish notary (notario). (3) The deed is filed with the Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil Central / provincial registry of the registered office); registration confers legal personality. (4) Within one month of registration, the SL files Modelo 036 again to secure the definitive NIF (corporate CIF format: letter 'B' followed by 8 digits for an SL) and to complete the census of taxpayers (Censo de Obligados Tributarios) and the VAT census. (5) The legal representative (administrador) obtains an AEAT electronic certificate and registers the SL for remote e-filing of corporate income tax (Modelo 200), VAT (Modelo 303/390), annual information returns (Modelo 347, Modelo 349), and SII if the turnover threshold is met. (6) For the TikTok Shop activity, no statutory sectoral license is required, but the SL must register the economic activity in the IAE (Modelo 036) and, when applicable, appoint a customs representative or engage a Spanish customs agent for export declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: The Spanish SL is a resident corporate entity mandatorily subject to Impuesto sobre Sociedades (Ley 27/2014, art. 7) on worldwide income; no pass-through eligibility exists for an SL; territorial scope: worldwide taxation based on incorporation or place of effective management in Spain; not eligible for tax-exempt-zone treatment on the mainland (Canary Islands ZEC regime is territorial and market-entry specific, not applicable by default).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or elective classification regime exists under Spanish law; corporate status follows legal form. Available elective mechanisms for an SL: (i) consolidated tax group (régimen de consolidación fiscal, art. 64 LIS) where a Spanish parent holds at least 70% direct or indirect participation; (ii) VAT group treatment (art. 163 quinquies LIVA) for entities linked by more than 50% control with financial, economic, and organizational interconnection; (iii) the EU One-Stop-Shop (OSS) election, both Union and non-Union schemes, via the Spanish Sede Electrónica for cross-border distance sales of goods supplied through digital platforms; (iv) anti-hybrid mismatch treatment (ATAD 2, arts. 61A-61T LIS) applies automatically, with no elective opt-in; (v) the patent box regime (art. 23 LIS) can be elected for qualifying intangible income, relevant only if the SL obtains proprietary algorithmic or software rights.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido) - Spanish value added tax governed by Ley 37/1992, harmonized with EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; TikTok Shop platform rules may deem the marketplace liable for VAT on certain B2C supplies, but the Spanish SL remains the taxable person of record for export and input VAT purposes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary registration threshold for a Spanish-established SL: VAT registration is compulsory from the first taxable transaction (arts. 5 and 164.1.a LIVA). For non-established EU merchants, the intra-Community distance-sales threshold is EUR 10,000 per calendar year for aggregate EU distance sales; crossing it shifts VAT liability to the destination Member State. Non-EU sellers are registrable from the first supply without threshold. The SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) applies to taxpayers whose turnover exceeds EUR 6,000,000; smaller SLs file quarterly Modelo 303.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Spain does not operate a centralized real-time pre-clearance system comparable to Italy's SDI. Mandatory rules: (1) Verifactu (art. 12, Ley 11/2021, and Royal Decree 1007/2023): every invoicing software must be a 'qualified billing system' emitting verifiable invoices in the VERIFACTU XML/JSON v1.0 format, including a QR code and chained hash integrity, with full third-party audit track; (2) Ley Crea y Crece (Ley 18/2022): universal B2B e-invoicing in structured format is being phased in for all Spanish businesses; taxpayers with turnover above EUR 8,000,000 are subject to the obligation approximately one year after the implementing regulation (early 2026 in practice), and all other taxpayers within a further year (2027); (3) SII real-time reporting is mandatory only for taxpayers above EUR 6,000,000 turnover, or those in a VAT group, or under certain large-company regimes; records are transmitted to AEAT via published API web services (XSD schemas) within 4 business days of invoice issuance and 8 calendar days of invoice receipt; no stamping is required for ordinary SME invoices; (4) if the SL operates in the Basque Country, TicketBAI invoicing with a signed QR and near-real-time transmission to the provincial tax authority applies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods by the Spanish SL are exempt with credit of input VAT (0% rate) under art. 21.1 Ley 37/1992. Conditions: (i) goods must be physically dispatched or transported outside the European Union by the SL or a third party on its behalf; (ii) the SL must hold ownership or the power of disposition over the goods; (iii) the removal from the EU must be completed within 3 months from dispatch unless justified causes are proven; (iv) the SL must be identified as the exporter in the customs declaration; (v) for low-value TikTok Shop e-commerce orders shipped by parcel to Latin America or other third countries, the SL must substantiate the end-to-end sale and dispatch chain, the final delivery outside the EU, and the receipt of the foreign currency proceeds; (vi) ancillary services linked to the export (international transport, loading, commission, and brokerage) are also zero-rated under arts. 21.2-21.5 LIVA. Exports to the Canary Islands, Ceuta, and Melilla are treated as outside the EU VAT scope under art. 22 LIVA.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (DUA) submitted through the CEX system stating the ES_SL as declarant and exporter, with the customs procedure code (such as 1005) and the export authorization notice (IE-590) confirming physical exit of the goods from the EU
Commercial invoice and packing list with full description, Incoterms, itemized values in EUR, and TikTok Shop order reference

Bill of Lading (B/L) for sea freight, Air Waybill (AWB) for air freight, or CMR/parcel carrier manifest for international road or courier deliveries, evidencing the origin in Spain and final destination outside the EU

Proof of customs exit and arrival in the third-country destination, including electronic customs 'comunicación de salida' records, destination customs entry documentation where available, and courier delivery scans

Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a Spanish financial institution, or a SWIFT MT103 credit advice, evidencing settlement of the export proceeds and compliance with Banco de España foreign-transaction declaration rules (Circular 1/2010)

Internal order-to-shipment reconciliation report (order log, tracking numbers, payout statements from TikTok Shop, and bank receipts or Wise B2B settlement advice) to corroborate genuine export transactions
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT dedicates targeted audit programs to e-commerce export chains and artificial export schemes. Consequences of non-compliance: (i) where the factual or documentary conditions of art. 21 LIVA are not met, the zero-rated supply is recharacterized as a domestic taxable supply and Spanish VAT at 21% is assessed on the export price (art. 88.1 LIVA); (ii) input VAT previously recovered on goods or services tied to the invalidated export is clawed back, with any related export refunds recovered, plus statutory late-payment interest (interés de demora, approximately 5.2% for 2025 under art. 26 LGT); (iii) administrative penalties under arts. 191-193 LGT range from 50% to 150% of the tax base, depending on the severity ('leve', 'grave', or 'muy grave'), based on intent and concealment; (iv) for documented false or sham export dossiers, the criminal tax fraud offense of art. 305 Código Penal applies when the defrauded amount exceeds EUR 120,000, with imprisonment of 1 to 5 years, fines of up to 6 times the defrauded amount, and potential joint and several liability of the administrators and facilitating platform intermediaries under art. 42.2 LGT; (v) the SL may lose its right to future zero-rating, be excluded from OSS schemes, and be placed on AEAT's public debtor list (art. 95b LGT), with adverse effects on the TikTok Shop seller account and banking relationships.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), exercising monetary authority within the Eurosystem and the ECB Single Supervisory Mechanism, and administratively responsible for foreign-transaction statistical declarations (Real Decreto 1727/2003) and the Registro de Inversiones Exteriores (Real Decreto 664/1999).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full euro convertibility on both current and capital accounts. Spain applies no exchange-control approval regime; capital movements and profit repatriation are liberalized under TFEU Articles 63–66 and Real Decreto-ley 5/2005. An ES_SL may freely remit dividends to non-resident shareholders, subject only to domestic withholding tax (generally 19%), possible reduction under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (Directive 2011/96/EU) or an applicable double-tax treaty, and the standard corporate income tax filing obligations. No central-bank authorization is required for remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Spain imposes no statutory timeline, no surrender obligation, and no mandatory EUR conversion ratio for export proceeds; the ES_SL may retain TikTok Shop payout proceeds in foreign currency (e.g., USD) in a multi-currency account. However, Banco de España statistical reporting under Real Decreto 1727/2003 applies: a balance-of-payments declaration is due when an individual payment or receipt with a non-resident reaches EUR 50,000 or more, with aggregate monthly declarations for recurring cross-border flows; the monetary means of payment declaration (S1) triggers separately at EUR 10,000 for cash or bearer instruments.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EUR Account; Capital Escrow Account (Certificado bancario de constitución) available for incorporation deposits
Operational EUR/USD Multi-Currency Account; Capital Escrow Account for incorporation; merchant acquiring integration
Operational EUR Account with SEPA Credit Transfer/direct debit rails and e-commerce settlement gateways
Operational EUR Account; trade finance desk for commercial letters of credit and supply-chain disbursements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Wise B2B (Wise Europe SA, a Belgian-licensed Electronic Money Institution passporting into Spain under PSD2) is operationally viable as an ancillary rail for EUR/SEPA settlements and multi-currency USD receipts from foreign TikTok Shop marketplaces; feasibility rating: High for payment-flow optimization, Low as a sole statutory banking partner. Legal constraints: (i) an EMI is not a credit institution and cannot issue the certificado bancario required for SL incorporation, so at least one Tier-1 Spanish credit institution remains mandatory; (ii) the EMI must be registered with the Banco de España under the passport notification procedure and remain subject to AML supervision (Ley 10/2010); (iii) EMI funds do not carry Spanish Deposit Guarantee Fund (FGD) protection; and (iv) the ES_SL must mirror its Tier-1 KYC file for the EMI, including UBO declarations and source-of-funds evidence.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote identification of natural persons is legally permissible under Ley 10/2010, as amended, and Real Decreto 266/2021 via secure video-identification or advanced electronic signature (DNIe). In practice, Tier-1 banks require a physical interview of at least one administrador (director) at a Spanish branch, or the issuance of a notarized and apostilled power of attorney in favor of a local representative, before signing the account mandate. Resident administrators with DNIe may complete digital onboarding with a subsequent video call; non-resident directors are generally required to appear in person, provide an apostilled passport copy, certified proof of address, and a Spanish NIE (no de extranjero), extending onboarding to 3–6 weeks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency, low-value TikTok Shop payout flows algorithmically resembling e-commerce micro-cash layering, with revenue concentration in a single non-domestic marketplace platform.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Order-level payout reports and settlement statements from TikTok Shop; auditable sales-log reconciliation; the signed platform seller agreement; API transaction ledger exports; a low-risk AML self-assessment and internal manual under Ley 10/2010 and Real Decreto 304/2014; and registration evidence of the economic activity (modelo 036/037).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owner (e.g., LatAm- or China-resident shareholder) with opaque source-of-funds for capital injections and share premium.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled constitutional documents and certified extract from the Registro Mercantil; formal UBO declaration (declaración de titular real); bank, brokerage, or tax statements evidencing lawful funds accumulation; tax residence certificates; and Form DP-1 filed with the Registro de Inversiones Exteriores where the foreign investment threshold applies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border disbursements to Chinese or Hong Kong procurement counterparties, and USD-denominated routing inconsistent with the declared EU retail activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial contracts, purchase orders, and customs declarations evidencing physical goods flow; supplier due-diligence file; SWIFT MT103 instructions with precise purpose codes and commercial invoice references; corroborating logistics agreements and warehouse receipts demonstrating real economic substance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: foreign shareholders credit the ES_SL account via SEPA Credit Transfer (EEA origin) or SWIFT MT103 (non-EEA origin), referencing 'Aportación de capital social' plus the notarial incorporation instrument number and the company NIF; funds are booked to paid-in share capital and any share premium. If the foreign investor reaches a 10% or greater equity stake or the investment exceeds EUR 3,000,000, the transaction must be declared to the Registro de Inversiones Exteriores within one month (Form DP-1); a Banco de España balance-of-payments statistical declaration is filed where the operation is EUR 50,000 or more. Prior exchange-control authorization is not required. The bank additionally requires a completed source-of-funds questionnaire, board/minutes approval, and the authenticated identity documentation of each contributing shareholder before crediting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails: SWIFT MT103 for non-EEA supplier settlements (USD, CNY, GBP) and for TikTok Shop platform fees; SEPA Credit Transfer for EUR disbursements within the EEA; irrevocable at-sight Commercial Letters of Credit via a confirming bank for large bulk restocking from Asia, allocating documentary and political risk; and Wise B2B or the marketplace's local settlement account for consolidated the inbound TikTok Shop Payout receipts. All outbound disbursements must reconcile with the Banco de España statistical declarations, the obligate invoicing/VAT framework for ISIC 4791 retail trade, and the tax-registration status (modelo 036/037).
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD outright forwards (plain-vanilla FXA) with authorized Spanish credit institutions or MiFID II investment firms, executed under an ISDA/CSA master agreement to hedge USD-denominated TikTok Shop payout receivables and procurement payables

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for Latin-American emerging-market currencies (e.g., MXN, COP, CLP, ARS) where local convertibility controls preclude physical delivery, with EUR/USD cash settlement and confirmed hedging-only purpose

Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD and EUR/GBP) for structural balance-sheet hedging of multi-currency marketplace receivables and supplier liabilities, with full ISDA collateralization and bank credit-line support

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual accounts (Cuentas Anuales) including directors' report and auditor's report if applicable, after shareholders' approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil) of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 31 December fiscal year-end: general shareholders' meeting must approve accounts within 6 months of year-end (by 30 June); filing with the Mercantile Registry must occur within 1 month of approval (by 30 July).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The company's registry file is closed (cierre registral), preventing registration of subsequent corporate acts; late-filing administrative fines may reach EUR 60,000; prolonged non-filing may lead to dissolution or judicial strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalisation / stamping of mandatory company books (Legalización de libros contables y corporativos)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first 4 months following the fiscal year close; for a 31 December fiscal year-end, before 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unlegalised books lose evidential validity in commercial litigation; further registry filings may be blocked; sanctions under Spanish Commercial Code and Registry Regulations may apply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days after the end of the 6-month period following the fiscal year close; for calendar-year taxpayers, by 25 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharges, interest for late payment, and tax penalties up to 150% of the assessed shortfall; persistent non-filing may trigger asset attachments and joint director liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-ownership confirmation (Confirmación de titularidad real) filed as part of the annual accounts deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same as deposit of annual accounts: by 30 July for a 31 December fiscal year-end, reflecting any shareholding or control changes known at that date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or inaccurate UBO information constitutes an infringement under Law 10/2010, subject to fines up to EUR 100,000; the registry file remains blocked until the disclosure is corrected.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statement of transactions with third parties (Modelo 347), required when an individual counterparty transaction volume exceeds EUR 3,005.06 per year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year transactions: 1 February to 1 March of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or incomplete filing may result in fines between EUR 300 and EUR 15,000 depending on the nature and repeat of the infringement; inaccurate data may attract increased penalties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit is required for an SL meeting at least two of the following in two consecutive fiscal years: (i) balance sheet total exceeding EUR 4,000,000; (ii) net turnover exceeding EUR 8,000,000; (iii) average headcount exceeding 50 employees. Audit is also compulsory in capital-market or group-subsidiary scenarios and for entities requesting certain state aid or public contracts above regulated thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP: Plan General de Contabilidad (PGC) and the simplified Plan General de Contabilidad de PYMES, aligned with EU Directive 2013/34/EU. IFRS as endorsed by the EU is mandatory for consolidated accounts of listed groups and optional for other groups and individual accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must maintain an internal register of ultimate beneficial owners and confirm that register as part of the annual accounts deposit. Any transfer of participations, change of directorship, change of control, or other material UBO change must be notarially instrumented and filed at the Mercantile Registry within one month of the underlying corporate decision. The registry will not adopt subsequent filings until the UBO confirmation is consistent with the ownership ledger.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro registro de socios)
Register of Directors (Libro registro de administradores)
Inventory and Annual Accounts Books required by the Commercial Code, legalised annually at the Mercantile Registry and kept physically at the registered office

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 – 1,200 per year for professional registered-office and secretarial services (EUR 300 – 1,000).
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,200 – 8,600 per audit engagement for a typical small or medium-sized SL (EUR 2,800 – 7,600).
